verified_mechanisms.details: Quota reserved in SQLite before HTTP dispatch; commits spent_requests atomically.
Reserved quota remains decremented after simulated process crash; no quota restoration.
Vaulting official evidence transitions status to CONSUMED via TrustedApprovalStore.consume_approval.
Subsequent requests with consumed token fail closed with STATUS_CONSUMED regardless of remaining attempt quota.
SQLite atomic transaction and thread locking prevent race conditions and overspending under concurrent load.
